title: The beeping cabinet in the basement
description: A building caretaker with no network knowledge describes sounds, lights and a sticker. Colleagues have to guess what he means ('the thing with lots of cables' = AGG-7 = RTR-021), and a field engineer works out the cause (one of two power feeds lost). Tests a lay description that must be translated into an element and a diagnosis.
subject: #facilities-oulu

incident.summary: Alarm active on RTR-021 after a storm (reported as a beeping cabinet)

messages.text: Hei, sorry to bother the network people. in the basement at Linnanmaa the tall cabinet is beeping, two short beeps every minute or so, since the storm last night
also one of the things with lots of cables has a yellow light blinking
hmm. which room, the server room or the one next to the lift?
the server room. cabinet number 3. the thing has a sticker AGG-7
AGG-7 is RTR-021, the aggregation switch. traffic looks fine on my side, there's an alarm active tho
beeping + yellow light on AGG-7 sounds like it lost one of its two power feeds. it runs fine on the other one, it just complains
Heikki is there a breaker in that room labelled F2? probably tripped in the storm
yes F2, it is down. should I flip it?
yes only that one, nothing else 👍
done. beeping stopped and the light is green now ✅
alarm cleared on my side too, thanks Heikki!
next time the same: breaker F2 first, no need to call us at night

items.summary: When RTR-021 (AGG-7, Oulu Linnanmaa) beeps and shows a yellow light it has lost one of its two power feeds, usually breaker F2 in the server room after a storm; switch F2 back on, nothing else.
items.diagnosis: one of the two power feeds is lost, the switch keeps running on the other
items.action: Switch breaker F2 in the Linnanmaa server room back on.
avoid: call the team at night first
items.evidence: seq 10: 'beeping stopped and the light is green now'
